name: Thwackey
description: Thwackey, the Beat Pokémon, and the evolved form of Grookey. Able to evolve into Rillaboom. A Grass type.
pokedex_entries: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
